data.desc: BIO-key is a global provider of biometric-centric Identity and Access Management (IAM) and authentication solutions, securing access for over forty million users across government, defense, financial services and enterprise customers. Its PortalGuard IAM platform, Identity-Bound Biometrics and FIDO-certified Passkey:YOU authentication give organizations flexible phoneless, tokenless and passwordless options to secure access to computers, applications, information and high-value transactions, whether cloud-hosted or on-premise.
